_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow: one stylized avatar head, 1024x1024, core nodes only (no custom nodes). POST this object as {"prompt": <this>} to http://127.0.0.1:8188/prompt, or run ops/avatar/comfyui/run.py. Node 2 = positive prompt, node 3 = negative, node 5 = sampler (seed lives here), node 1 = checkpoint name. No real face, no likeness: the prompt asks for an illustrated character, per hermes-youtube-avatar-head.

_meta.title: Checkpoint (SDXL base or any SDXL merge in models/checkpoints)

inputs.text: front-facing bust portrait of a stylized illustrated character, friendly confident expression, looking straight at camera, clean vector-inspired shading, smooth cel shading, centered composition, head and shoulders, plain soft-gradient studio background, soft key light, sharp focus, high detail, original character design, no text, no watermark, no logo

photograph, photorealistic, real person, celebrity, deformed, extra fingers, extra limbs, cropped head, side profile, multiple people, text, caption, watermark, logo, signature, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, nsfw

_meta.title: Sampler (change seed for a new head)
